## Data provenance (required for anything that shows sensing data)
- [ ] Nothing simulated or replayed is presented as live ESP32 capture
- [ ] Any simulated / dataset data on screen carries a visible Simulated / Dataset badge
- [ ] No accuracy claim (especially fall detection) is made without a recorded experiment behind it

## Safety checklist
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files or database files committed
- [ ] New endpoints have role checks and organization scoping, with tests for the denied cases
- [ ] A migration is included for every model change
- [ ] Corporate users still cannot reach elder-care data; elder-care organizations stay isolated from each other
